displayName: PVACD pipeline — sync failure (Workflow execution FAILED)

documentation.content:
A `pvacd-daily` Cloud Workflows execution finished with status `FAILED`.

This is the top-level sync-failure signal for the PVACD pipeline: it fires when the orchestration (ingest -> transform) could not complete a run, whether the failure came from the ingest function, the transform function, or the workflow itself.

**Triage:** open the failed execution in Workflows, then the logs of the step that raised. Common causes: HydroVu auth/credentials, the transform unable to reach FROST on Cloud Run (VPC egress / FROST down), or Cloud SQL unavailable.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/Workflow" AND metric.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/finished_execution_count" AND metric.labels.status = "FAILED" AND resource.labels.workflow_id = "pvacd-daily"
